As of 30 November 2026, Siddharth Ranade (S2026CS012) has accumulated a total late fine of **₹5,500** on his overdue fee components [SQL].

Here is the breakdown of the overdue components, days overdue, and their respective late fines:

* **tuition_inst1**: ₹5,000 (108 days overdue; calculated as 108 days × ₹100/day = ₹10,800 capped at ₹5,000 per component) [SQL, Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §4].
* **exam**: ₹500 (30 days overdue; flat fee charged for late examination) [SQL, Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §4].

Total late fine: ₹5,000 + ₹500 = **₹5,500**.
sql: SELECT component, amount_due, amount_paid, due_date, (CAST('2026-11-30' AS DATE) - due_date) AS days_overdue, CASE WHEN component = 'exam' THEN 500 ELSE LEAST((CAST('2026-11-30' AS DATE) - due_date) * 100, 5000) END AS late_fine FROM fee_ledger WHERE student_id = 'S2026CS012' AND status = 'overdue' ORDER BY due_date LIMIT 200
